backgrounds: A single location for the entire episode: an indoor home dining room where a stop-motion felt-textured couple sits at a small round wooden dinner table. The background is a softly blurred, warm neutral interior (tan/cream wall paneling, a hint of a doorway and what looks like a kitchen counter with bottles on a shelf) rendered with shallow depth of field so it stays out of focus and never becomes a second distinct set. Title/intro cards use a plain solid black background with no set at all.
props: Two white dinner plates with food (what looks like meat/potatoes and small pastries)
Cutlery (forks, knives) laid on the table
A smartphone held by the male character (the recurring 'low battery' phone-distraction prop)
Small background bottles on a shelf implying a kitchen area
Yellow 'NEW EPISODE DAILY' torn-paper/ticket graphic used in the title card
lighting_notes: Warm, soft, even interior lighting typical of stop-motion/claymation sets, with gentle key light on the characters' faces and a softly lit, defocused background; no harsh shadows or dramatic contrast, giving a cozy, naturalistic domestic feel. The intro/title slate cuts to flat black with no lighting at all.
color_palette: golden yellow (title text and episode-tag graphic)
visual_complexity_notes: The set is minimal and static: one camera setup, one table, two characters, and a deliberately blurred generic background so nothing competes with the characters' exaggerated expressions and the phone prop. This is a stylized, low-complexity environment consistent with a short-form daily episodic format, keeping full focus on facial reactions and the phone-versus-partner joke rather than on set detail.
